description.en: Keep this cell as published. This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. On this low-pressure row the 24 mm cell is 80 m horizontal / 240 m vertical, and the motor is 75 kW. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric Low Pressure 60 at 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, hopper 0.5 m³, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. Taken from the printed row: The model cell also prints Electric 75-60. Keep this cell as published. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 60, which prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm stone 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki double pump 112, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is not a Pinjin contract record. Taken from the printed row: This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
